title_zh: 区分短片媒体预览和公开发布

scenario.label_zh: 协调短片预览与公开宣传日程
scenario.goal_zh: 区分媒体预览、公开放映与上线时间，并分工准备宣传材料和发送前核对

context_zh: 短片宣传协调员格斯与剪辑师埃拉核对已完成影片的宣传安排，所有项目和时间均为虚构。
author: author-phase06-a

sentences.speaker: Gus
sentences.text: Can we start telling people about the film now?

sentences.speaker: Ella
sentences.text: Yes. Production is finished, and the producer has approved this final version.

sentences.speaker: Gus
sentences.text: Good. The local press have asked for a preview. I can offer them a private screening on Thursday.

sentences.speaker: Ella
sentences.text: That works, but the public screening is on Friday. We will release the film online the following Monday.

sentences.speaker: Gus
sentences.text: Then I will put all three dates in the invitation so nobody confuses them.

sentences.speaker: Ella
sentences.text: How will we promote the public screening? We do not have money for paid adverts.

sentences.speaker: Gus
sentences.text: With the approved poster on our club page and a short announcement at the library. I will handle both.

sentences.speaker: Ella
sentences.text: Great. I will prepare the preview link for the journalists. Send me your invitation before it goes out.

sentences.speaker: Gus
sentences.text: I will. You can check the dates and the link together.
